body:
HOLD (Fable2, 2026-11-27 15:26Z, Opus2 #8265/#8266). All TermAl FULL gates on EVERY host are held until P0 w-da332f6df745 lands. The test terminal_run_route_proxies_valid_remote_multibyte_commands configures an enabled SSH remote (example.com:22, alice) on loopback. If its /api/health probe fails or times out, ensure_available (src/remote.rs ~1139-1167) calls start_process, which runs the system ssh. Under Greg's absolute ssh ban, an agent-launched FULL that can run ssh isn't allowed.
- Focused runs that demonstrably exclude the test or module may continue.
- No filtered "full" gate.
- w-da33's fix candidate's own FULL runs UNFILTERED, because the candidate removes the path by construction. The pair must first confirm (a) an injected non-network starter for ALL tests reaching start_process with an enabled remote, all audited, and (b) a behavioural test that a failed probe never spawns ssh.
- After it lands: w-1f9d R2, then ee06's Windows FULL, then the rest.
- Greg was informed (Asistant #2953).
Lift this hold when w-da33 lands.
